semantics.identity_rule: Each Lens definition/preset has explicit identity.
semantics.parameter_rule: Projection parameters are explicit and typed.
semantics.preset_rule: Saved presets persist parameter values, not hidden semantic authority.
semantics.projection_rule: Lens visualization/analysis does not mutate source by default.
semantics.derived_rule: Rankings/layouts/coordinates are derived evidence/projection unless a domain contract explicitly says otherwise.
semantics.authority_rule: Lens visibility/selection grants no source authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.
